_comment: The Natuurwerkdag's volunteer jobs (klussen), read by mapsee_ingest_natuurwerkdag.py. The finder page /klussen/ decides which jobs exist and when and where (one request, every card plus the site's own map points); jobs-sitemap.xml only says which job pages changed (lastmod); a job page only adds its description, meeting point, the organiser's kids flag and whether sign-up has closed. Pages are cached by lastmod in --cache, which is also the resume cursor.
_conduct: Checked 2026-10-24 with our own User-Agent: https://www.natuurwerkdag.nl/robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' with no Crawl-delay. The site publishes no terms of use: https://www.natuurwerkdag.nl/disclaimer/ disclaims accuracy and liability only, and https://www.natuurwerkdag.nl/privacyverklaring-en-cookies/ covers participants' data. The adapter copies no person: not the organiser's e-mail (a data-email attribute), not the site manager named in the quote block, and no description sentence that gives an e-mail address, a phone number or a named contact.

sites.name: Natuurwerkdag
sites._found: manual:2026-10-24 discovery agent: jobs-sitemap.xml lists 551 klussen, robots.txt Allow: /, the 'jobs' post type is not in /wp-json/wp/v2/types, no Event JSON-LD and no iCal. The Netherlands had no curated volunteer source.
sites._measured: 2026-10-24: /klussen/ lists 530 jobs in one 2 MB page (FacetWP pager total_rows 530): 417 on Saturday 7 November 2026 and 113 on Friday 6 November, 514 with a clock. 523 carry a map point, equal to the job page's own data-lat/lng on 15 of 15 sampled; 6 have no point anywhere and 1 title carries a wp-admin URL, so 523 pass the listing checks; 2 more name another day in the title than on the card ('Kom 'n weekje eerder helpen op zaterdag 31 oktober', 'Zaterdag 31 okt.: ...', both dated Friday 6 November) and are refused, while the other 31 titles that name a day name their own. jobs-sitemap.xml lists 551: the 21 extra are hidden shells (one is 'test Marije') whose only date is another job's. Of the 86 distinct job pages read that day (the live runs' 50, a first sample of 22 and 15 read in review): 13 full (sign-up closed), 56 'Geschikt voor kinderen', 70 with a meeting point, 1 closed to the public ('Dit is een besloten klus voor schoolklassen', a Natuurwerkdag Junior job), and 4 with one description sentence giving a contact, dropped (a named person's mobile on 3, an organisation's e-mail on 1); 0 of 15 compared disagree with the listing. No point lies more than 71 km from the median of its province's jobs. The sitemap lastmod moved on 4-26 jobs a day from 2026-10-12 to 10-23. Live run on a scratch store (--max-minutes 0.75), before the review's fixes: 42 requests in 46 s, 40 pages read, 518 rows kept (517 records: one double posting), 6 no point, 1 URL title, 5 full; a second run (--max-minutes 0.25) served those 40 from the cache for 0 requests and read the next 9 (11 requests). Of those 49 pages: 7 full, 35 kids, 45 with a meeting point, 0 contact sentences (the rate is the 86 pages' 4, not this sample's 0). After them: 41 requests in 46 s, 515 kept (514 records), 2 more refused for a title naming another day and 1 Junior job held; the second run 13 requests, 39 from the cache. Points: 15 of 501 carry 2 different titles, 12 of them a site's Friday and Saturday jobs; the most on one day is 2 (3 points), so max_titles_per_point (counted per day) is 3.
sites.signup_line: A Natuurwerkdag volunteer job: sign up on its page at natuurwerkdag.nl.
sites._refresh_comment: A cached page is read again when its lastmod moves, when its date/clock/point disagrees with the listing, or after refresh_days - at most max_refresh_per_run of those per run, oldest first, so the first run's 523 reads do not all come due on one day. Full jobs are the reason for the age refresh: a sign-up does not move lastmod.
sites._points_comment: A point is a default pin, not a site, when it carries more than max_titles_per_point DIFFERENT titles on one day. Measured max 2 on one day (A Rocha's morning and afternoon, two jobs of one farm, one job posted twice); 3 leaves room for one more session.
